description: MCP context describing lightweight background servers (agents) to support a client-side in-browser meme/remix app.

servers.name: Link Service
servers.purpose: Generate short, shareable permalinks for exported remixes; optionally host small blobs or redirect to CDN storage.

servers.name: Template Manager
servers.purpose: Host and version template packs (free/paid/sponsored). Provide search, preview generation, and access controls.

servers.name: Moderation Agent
servers.purpose: Automated content safety checks (NSFW, hate symbols, personal info) on uploads and shared links; queue human review when needed.

servers.name: Analytics Agent
servers.purpose: Collect anonymized usage events, share metrics, and power A/B tests and growth hooks.

servers.name: Storage/CDN Gateway
servers.purpose: Store user exports, template assets, and thumbnails; serve files via CDN or signed URLs.

servers.name: Payments & Licenses
servers.purpose: Handle donations, one-off template purchases, license issuance, and webhooks from payment providers.

servers.name: Campaign / Viral Growth Bot
servers.purpose: Manage scheduled promotions, sponsor templates rotations, and optional social-share automation (owner-authorized).
